questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He has been ______ my birthday all week.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'celebrating'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **present perfect continuous tense**.
 
• In the present perfect continuous tense, **"v1 + ing"** is used.
 
• So, **'celebrating'** is the correct word for the blank. 

 

**So, the complete sentence is-** *He has been **celebrating** my birthday all week.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The present perfect continuous tense is used to show **something started in the past and is continuing at the present time**.
 
• The present perfect continuous is formed using the construction **"has/have been + v1 + ing + time"**.
 
 
• **E.g.** I have been running for an hour.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य वर्तमान पूर्ण निरंतर काल (present perfect continuous tense) में है।
 
• वर्तमान पूर्ण निरंतर काल में, **"v1 + ing"** का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
 
• तो, 'celebrating' रिक्त स्थान के लिए सही शब्द है।

 

**तो पूरा वाक्य है - ***He has been celebrating my birthday all week.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** *

__
 
• वर्तमान पूर्ण निरंतर काल (present perfect continuous tense) का उपयोग **कुछ ऐसा दिखाने के लिए किया जाता है जो अतीत में शुरू हुआ और वर्तमान समय में जारी है।**
 
• वर्तमान पूर्ण निरंतर का निर्माण है - **has/have been + v1 + ing + time।**
 
 
• **उदा**. I have been running for an hour.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement.**

Though a hero, he acted __a coward__.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'like a coward'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Like'** is used to **compare** two things.

 
 
• **E.g.** A little boy **like his father** has beautiful eyes.
 
 
 
• The given sentence **compares** a **hero **with a **coward**.
 
• According to the rule given above, **'like a coward'** will be used in the underlined part of the sentence.

 

**Correct Sentence**__: *Though a hero, he acted **like a coward**.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

__
 
• **'Though'** is a **subordinate conjunction** that means **'despite the fact that'**.
 
• A subordinating conjunction is a conjunction that is used to **join** a **subordinating clause** to **another clause or sentence**.
 
 
• **E.g.** **Though** he gave no sign, I was sure he had seen me.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• '**Like**' का प्रयोग **दो चीजों की तुलना करने के लिए किया जाता है।**

 
 
• उदा. A little boy** like his father** has beautiful eyes.
 
 
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में नायक की तुलना कायर से की गयी है।
 
• ऊपर दिए गए नियम के अनुसार वाक्य के रेखांकित भाग में 'like a coward' का प्रयोग होगा।

 ​

**सही वाक्य:** *Though a hero, he acted like a coward.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** *

 
• '**Though**' एक अधीनस्थ संयोजन (subordinate conjunction) है जिसका अर्थ है** 'इस तथ्य के बावजूद'**।
 
• एक अधीनस्थ संयोजन एक संयोजन है जो एक अधीनस्थ खंड को किसी अन्य खंड या वाक्य में शामिल करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।
 
 
• उदा. Though he gave no sign, I was sure he had seen me.

The errors for the typed reports were so numerous that they could hardly be overlooked.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'errors for'.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence the error lies in the **wrong usage** of the **preposition 'for'**.
 
• **'For'** is generally used to show** "a reason, a duration of time, or to specify the use of something".**
 
• Among the many uses of **'in',** one is that it is used **"to indicate something contained within something"**. 
 
 
• **E.g. **all the paintings **in** the collection.
 
 
 
• The given sentence means that the** reports contained many errors**. 
 
• Therefore, **'in' **will be used instead of **'for'** after 'errors'.

 

**Correct Sentence:**__ *The errors **in** the typed reports were so numerous that they could hardly be overlooked.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

__
 
• **Meanings of important words:**

 
 
• **Numerous**- existing in large numbers. (बड़ी संख्या में विद्यमान)
 
• **Overlook**- to fail to see or notice something. (कुछ देखने या नोटिस करने में असफल होना)
 
 
 
• **'Hardly'** is an adverb that means** "almost no; almost not; almost none"**. (मुश्किल से)
 
 
• **E.g.** There is **hardly** any milk in the container.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__

• '**For**' आमतौर पर **"एक कारण, समय की अवधि, या किसी चीज़ के उपयोग को निर्दिष्ट करने के लिए"** दिखाने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है।
 
• '**In**' के कई उपयोगों में से एक यह है कि इसका उपयोग **"किसी चीज़ के भीतर निहित किसी चीज़ को इंगित करने के लिए"** किया जाता है।
 
• उदा. all the paintings in the collection.
 
• दिए गए वाक्य का अर्थ है कि रिपोर्ट में कई त्रुटियां थीं।
 
• इसलिए, 'errors' के बाद '**for**' के ​​बजाय '**in**' का उपयोग किया जाएगा।

 

**सही वाक्य:** *The errors in the typed reports were so numerous that they could hardly be overlooked.*

questions.question:

Had you told me that you were in Mumbai, I could have certainly contacted you instead of waiting here.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'could have'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a **conditional sentence**. 
 
• Conditional sentences are used **to express** that the action in the main clause (without if) can only take place if a certain condition (in the clause with if) is fulfilled.
 
• If the **'if clause'** is in the **past perfect tense**, the following structure is followed:
 
 
• If + Sub + had + v3.............**would have** + v3

 (OR)
 
• Had + Sub + v3.................**would have** + v3
 
 
 
• According to the rule given above, **'would have'** will be used instead of** 'could have'**.

 

**Correct Sentence__: ***Had you told me that you were in Mumbai I **would have** certainly contacted you instead of waiting here.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

__
 
• **The past perfect tense** is used to talk about actions that were completed before some point in the past.
 
• **'Had + v3' **is used in the past perfect tense.​* *
 
 
• E.g. I **had met** him before the event.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

• दिया गया वाक्य सशर्त वाक्य (conditional sentence) है।
 
• सशर्त वाक्यों (Conditional sentence) का उपयोग यह व्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है कि मुख्य खंड (main clause) (बिना अगर) में कार्रवाई केवल तभी हो सकती है जब एक निश्चित शर्त (यदि के साथ खंड में) पूरी हो।
 
• यदि 'if क्लॉज' past perfect tense में है, तो निम्नलिखित संरचना का पालन किया जाता है:
 
 
• If + Sub + had + v3.............would have + v3

 (OR)
 
• Had + Sub + v3.................would have + v3
 
 
 
• ऊपर दिए गए नियम के अनुसार, 'would have' के स्थान पर 'could have' का प्रयोग किया जाएगा।

**सही वाक्य:** *Had you told me that you were in Mumbai I would have certainly contacted you instead of waiting here.*
